Housing complexes in Bengal adopt rooftop solar for reduced electricity costs

Several housing complexes in West Bengal are increasingly installing rooftop solar panels to lower their electricity bills. This trend is driven by the rising cost of conventional power. The Telegraph (India) reported on this shift, highlighting how residents are benefiting from reduced expenses. In a related development, Borosil Renewables is piloting rooftop solar projects with a revenue target of ₹100 crore, indicating broader industry interest in solar energy solutions.
